purpose: Fresh independent source-grounded qualification requests frozen before any v8 concept-search execution.
source_basis: The supplied frozen corpus is bound by an independently recomputed full source-tree digest and the selected owner-file hashes. The Git head identifies its base commit only.

provenance.authorship: Model-authored purposive sample, not human gold.
provenance.author_role: Separate fixture author with no access to the current retrieval implementation, policy contents or result artifacts.
provenance.current_retrieval_blindness: No current query/ranking implementation, retrieval policy file, concept-search execution, baseline report or candidate output was inspected.
provenance.historical_context_exposure: The required initial memory registry check exposed an October 15 historical retrieval summary before case selection. This fixture is blind to the current implementation and outputs, but not to all historical algorithmic background.
provenance.prior_fixture_inspection: Only anchor path/symbol identities, source-file key sets and schema/metadata were inspected to exclude spent owners. Earlier queries and retrieval outputs were not consulted.
provenance.freeze_contract: All ids, intents, queries, kinds, splits, top limits, source declarations and sparse judgments are frozen before the first v8 retrieval. No result-guided case selection or tuning.
provenance.digest_format: SHA-256 over UTF-8 canonical JSON with sorted keys, compact separators, non-ASCII preserved and non-finite numbers disallowed. Query-anchor payload is the case-order array of id/split/kind/query/top plus relevant and distractor path/symbol/declaration_line triples. Intent payload is the case-order array of id/kind/query/family/reason.

selection.method: Direct inspection of twelve previously unused runtime owner files. Requests describe user tasks and operations without requiring symbol names, signatures or paths.
selection.novelty: Every selected owner file is absent from all prior concept-relevance fixture source_files_sha256 maps, including v6 and v7.
limitations: Purposive single-repository requests are not a representative user-query population.
All twelve positive owners are Rust runtime declarations; this does not establish performance for other languages.
One exact positive declaration is labeled per request. Unlisted relevant siblings and other returned rows remain unjudged.
Negative judgments concern capabilities absent from the inspected nearby contracts. Lexical candidates do not establish those capabilities.
Historical algorithmic background was incidentally exposed by the mandatory memory check and is disclosed in provenance.

judgment_contract.positive: The exact runtime declaration is identified by source path, simple symbol, unique declaration line and a pinned source excerpt. Qualified names are retained when useful.
judgment_contract.distractor: A source-inspected nearby operation does not implement the requested unsupported capability. Every other row remains unjudged.
judgment_contract.negative: The requested operation is absent from the inspected adjacent contract and has no relevant anchor. No empty-page expectation is imposed.
judgment_contract.evidence: One-based inclusive excerpt bounds refer to the pinned source bytes; source evidence supplements delegated operations and explicit capability boundaries.

cases.query: Automatically mark every acceptance criterion satisfied when all recorded checks pass.

distractors.source_excerpt:
let draft = Submission {
        schema_version: 1,
        target_revision: target_revision.clone(),
        expected_review_revision: expected_review_revision.clone(),
        reviewer: Reviewer {
            kind: None,
            name: String::new(),
        },
        criteria: target
            .criteria
            .iter()
            .map(|criterion| CriterionAssessment {
                id: criterion.id.clone(),
                status: Judgment::Unknown,
                reason: String::new(),
                evidence: criterion
                    .checks
                    .iter()
                    .map(|id| format!("check:{id}"))
                    .collect(),
            })
            .collect(),
        verification_quality: unknown.clone(),
        scope_control: unknown.clone(),
        proportionality: unknown,
        history: Some(Decisions::unknown()),
    };
distractors.reason: The draft sets every criterion and each review dimension to Unknown, independently of the check references it supplies.

cases.reason: Recorded checks are review evidence. The packet requires explicit criterion judgments and never infers semantic satisfaction from passing checks.
